story.iWant: to view worker logs in a modal
story.soThat: I can troubleshoot issues without leaving the workers page
story.tasks:
### Frontend Implementation (9 tasks) - [ ] **Task 1**: Create `WorkerLogsModal.tsx` component with shadcn/ui Dialog - [ ] **Task 2**: Create `useWorkerLogs()` hook with React Query - [ ] **Task 3**: Implement log level color coding (`logParser.ts`) - [ ] **Task 4**: Add debounced search input (300ms delay) - [ ] **Task 5**: Implement auto-scroll toggle with session storage - [ ] **Task 6**: Add refresh button with loading state - [ ] **Task 7**: Implement download logs functionality (`downloadLogs.ts`) - [ ] **Task 8**: Integrate virtualized list (`react-window`) - [ ] **Task 9**: Add keyboard shortcuts (ESC, Ctrl+F, Ctrl+R, Ctrl+D)
### Testing (4 tasks) - [ ] **Task 10**: Write unit tests for `logParser.ts` (level detection, color mapping) - [ ] **Task 11**: Write unit tests for `downloadLogs.ts` (filename generation, content format) - [ ] **Task 12**: Write component tests for `WorkerLogsModal` (search, filter, toggle) - [ ] **Task 13**: Test error handling (404, 503, network errors)
### Integration (2 tasks) - [ ] **Task 14**: Update `workers/page.tsx` to add "View Logs" button to table actions - [ ] **Task 15**: Test modal open/close flow and focus management

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
### AC-1: View Logs Modal Opens ✅ **Given** I am viewing the workers list (Story 18) **When** I click "View Logs" action button for a worker **Then** a modal opens showing: - Worker hostname in modal header - Last 100 log lines (newest first, reverse chronological) - Timestamp for each log line (formatted: `HH:mm:ss`) - Log level color coding: ERROR (text-red-600), WARN (text-yellow-600), INFO (text-blue-600), DEBUG (text-gray-500) - Auto-scroll to bottom toggle (checkbox, default OFF) - Refresh button (fetches latest logs) - Download logs button (saves as `.txt` file) **And** modal styling: dark theme (bg-gray-900), monospace font, full-width (90vw/95vw), max height 80vh, ESC key closes
### AC-2: Log Level Color Coding Works ✅ **Given** the logs viewer modal is open **When** log entries are displayed **Then** each line's color matches its log level via regex `/\b(ERROR|WARN|INFO|DEBUG)\b/i` **And** line numbers displayed in left gutter (text-gray-600)
### AC-3: Search/Filter Logs ✅ **Given** the logs viewer modal is open **When** I type in the search input **Then** logs filtered in real-time (case-insensitive, debounced 300ms), highlights matches in yellow, shows count "Showing X of Y lines"
### AC-4: Auto-Scroll Toggle ✅ **Given** the logs viewer modal is open **When** I enable "Auto-scroll to bottom" toggle **Then** scrolls to bottom immediately and continuously during auto-refresh, persists in session storage per worker
### AC-5: Refresh Logs ✅ **Given** the logs viewer modal is open **When** I click "Refresh" button **Then** shows loading spinner, fetches latest 100 lines, replaces current logs, updates timestamp **And** keyboard shortcut: Ctrl+R/Cmd+R triggers refresh
### AC-6: Download Logs as .txt ✅ **Given** the logs viewer modal is open **When** I click "Download" button **Then** creates `.txt` file: `worker-{hostname}-logs-{timestamp}.txt` with format `[TIMESTAMP] [LEVEL] MESSAGE`, uses Blob + URL.createObjectURL
### AC-7: Virtualized List Performance ✅ **Given** 100+ log lines displayed **When** I scroll through logs **Then** uses virtualization (`react-window` or `@tanstack/react-virtual`), renders visible rows + buffer (10 above/below), smooth 60 FPS scrolling
### AC-8: Modal Keyboard Navigation ✅ **Given** the logs viewer modal is open **When** I use keyboard shortcuts **Then** ESC closes, Ctrl+F focuses search, Ctrl+R refreshes, Ctrl+D downloads, Tab navigates, focus trapped in modal
### AC-9: Error Handling ✅ **Given** the logs viewer modal is open **When** API errors occur **Then** appropriate error states: 404 (worker not found toast), 503 (API unavailable + retry), network error (connection error + retry)

story-context.constraints:
### From Architecture 1. **C1**: Use shadcn/ui components for modal (Dialog, Input, Button, Checkbox) - NOTE: Existing implementation uses Headless UI Dialog instead of shadcn/ui 2. **C2**: TypeScript strict mode enabled (tsconfig.json) 3. **C3**: Monospace font for logs (`font-mono`) 4. **C4**: Dark theme for logs viewer (`bg-gray-900` or `bg-gray-950`) 5. **C5**: Virtualization required for performance with 100+ log lines (AC-7) - **NOT YET IMPLEMENTED** 6. **C6**: Keyboard accessibility (focus trap, ESC to close, shortcuts) 7. **C7**: RBAC enforcement - Admin-only access (inherited from workers page) 8. **C8**: TanStack Query v5 patterns (staleTime, refetchInterval, retry) 9. **C9**: File size limit ≤500 lines per file (WorkerLogsModal.tsx is 348 lines - compliant) 10. **C10**: Test coverage ≥80% minimum, 95%+ target
### From Epic Documentation - API endpoint: `GET /api/v1/workers/{hostname}/logs?lines=N` (implemented in Story 17) - Log level detection via regex `/\b(ERROR|WARN|INFO|DEBUG)\b/i` - Dark theme for readability (reduces eye strain) - Monospace font for log text (improves structured log readability) - Focus management and keyboard shortcuts (accessibility requirement)
### From Design System (Apple Liquid Glass) - Modal max-width: `max-w-6xl` (90vw on mobile) - Modal height: `h-[80vh]` or `max-h-[85vh]` - Consistent spacing (4px/8px grid) - Color palette from `tailwind.config.ts` - Glassmorphic blur effects (`backdrop-blur-sm`)

tests.standards: Testing standards from development-guide.md: - **Framework**: Jest 30.2 + React Testing Library 16.3 - **Coverage Target**: 80% minimum, 95%+ preferred - **File Location**: `nextjs-ui/__tests__/` mirroring source structure - **Patterns**: - Unit tests for utils (`logParser.ts`, `downloadLogs.ts`) - Component tests for UI (`WorkerLogsModal.test.tsx`) - Integration tests for user flows (modal open → search → download → close) - Mock API calls with MSW (Mock Service Worker) - **Accessibility**: Test keyboard navigation, focus management, ARIA attributes - **Best Practices**: - Arrange-Act-Assert pattern - Test user behavior, not implementation details - Use `screen.getByRole()` over `getByTestId()` - Clean up after each test (unmount components, clear mocks)
tests.locations: - `nextjs-ui/__tests__/lib/utils/logParser.test.ts` (NEW - Task 10) - `nextjs-ui/__tests__/lib/utils/downloadLogs.test.ts` (NEW - Task 11) - `nextjs-ui/__tests__/components/workers/WorkerLogsModal.test.tsx` (EXISTS - verify coverage, Task 12) - `nextjs-ui/__tests__/integration/workers-logs-workflow.test.tsx` (OPTIONAL - E2E test with Playwright)
tests.ideas:
**AC-1 (Modal Opens):** - Test modal renders with correct hostname in header - Test initial fetch of 100 log lines - Test modal styling (dark theme, monospace font) - Test ESC key closes modal - Test close button (X) closes modal
**AC-2 (Color Coding):** - Unit test `logParser.ts`: parseLogLevel("ERROR: failed") returns { level: "ERROR", color: "text-red-600" } - Unit test each log level (ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, UNKNOWN) - Component test: log lines rendered with correct color classes - Test line numbers displayed in left gutter
**AC-3 (Search/Filter):** - Test search input filters logs (case-insensitive) - Test debouncing (300ms delay) - use fake timers - Test "Showing X of Y lines" count updates - Test clear button (X) resets filter - Test empty state: "No logs match your search"
**AC-4 (Auto-Scroll):** - Test toggle scrolls to bottom when enabled - Test scroll position preserved when disabled - Test session storage persistence (per worker) - Mock `scrollIntoView()` for testing
**AC-5 (Refresh):** - Test manual refresh button refetches logs - Test loading spinner shows during fetch - Test "Last refreshed" timestamp updates - Test keyboard shortcut Ctrl+R triggers refresh - Mock preventDefault to avoid browser reload
**AC-6 (Download):** - Unit test `downloadLogs.ts`: filename format `worker-{hostname}-logs-{timestamp}.txt` - Unit test content format: `[TIMESTAMP] [LEVEL] MESSAGE` - Test Blob creation and URL.createObjectURL - Test URL.revokeObjectURL cleanup - Mock `document.createElement('a')` and click()
**AC-7 (Virtualization):** - Test only visible rows rendered (check DOM node count) - Test scroll performance (no lag with 1000+ logs) - Test dynamic row height if multi-line logs - **NOTE**: This requires `react-window` or `@tanstack/react-virtual` to be installed and integrated
**AC-8 (Keyboard Navigation):** - Test ESC closes modal - Test Ctrl+F focuses search input - Test Ctrl+R triggers refresh - Test Ctrl+D triggers download - Test Tab cycles through interactive elements - Test focus trap (cannot tab to background) - Test initial focus on search input - Test focus restored to "View Logs" button on close
**AC-9 (Error Handling):** - Test 404 error: toast "Worker not found", disable refresh button - Test 503 error: toast "API unavailable", show retry button - Test network error: toast "Network error", show retry button - Test retry button re-attempts fetch - Mock API errors using MSW
